name: Affection and relationships
question: How do law and custom here treat love and closeness: affection in public, couples in private (sharing a room, unmarried and same-sex couples), how marriages and partnerships are recognised, and how all of this is changing?
sources: the level's own legislation and official visitor guidance
Smartraveller's local laws, local customs and LGBTQIA+ sections
the community's own published guidance for custom
fields: items[]: area, kind (law or custom), text, source, checked
rules: Every item says whether it is law or custom. Custom comes from the place's own published guidance, or is labelled a signal.
Written for every visitor, whoever they love: the same question for any couple.
Changing means dated changes in law or published official figures, never impressions.
Describe, don't moralise. No ranking of places or cultures.
Never store anything about the traveller's own relationships.
